name: dsh-wardbyte
description: Native DSH plugin for the Wardbyte binary-analysis toolkit: 26 model-facing tools (binary stats/parse/disassembly/diff/YARA/func-xref/capa/assessment, Keystone assembly, Unicorn emulation, filesystem/code-data queries, analyst notes) served by a persistent Python worker that drives the pip-installed wardbyte server core directly.
